items.title: Chevron (CVX) Meets US Officials Over Protecting Kazakhstan Oil Assets
items.summary: Chevron's CEO has met with senior US government officials to discuss measures to protect the company's oil assets in Kazakhstan. The talks focused on safeguarding large production operations in a region exposed to geopolitical and regulatory risks. The discussions highlight US interest in the security of Chevron's overseas energy infrastructure.
